description: Group-aware leakage-safe train/val/test split. All tiles of the same substrate are assigned to the same split. Confirmed MD5 duplicate pairs are merged into shared groups. The test split must remain real-only and must not be used for GAN training, synthetic sample selection, or hyperparameter tuning.
warnings: Vendor split had 189 groups crossing train/val/test boundaries. These are corrected in this group-aware split.
8 confirmed MD5 duplicate pairs merged into shared groups.
